title: Grids

content:
Update of the Mutable Instruments Grids module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with pattern length and offset settings added, also a reset function and a different UI.

notes : reset pattern

aux (hold) : check revision number and global CPU usage

#1 copy grids_2-5.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install grids_2-5.zop"

(will be installed into /media/orac/usermodules/sequence)

v2.5 : trigs and accents can be played on the keys (from F#2 to B2), other minor improvements

v2.4 : the "Offset" is now patched after the "Reset", that means we can navigate thru the pattern after reducing its length, for more possibilities

v2.3 : original notes routing restored for more compatibility (be sure to update Fusion to 1.5 also) and 2 routing pages added for more flexibility, trigs and accents length settings added

v2.2 : minor UI bugfix and changes

v2.1 : minor graphic changes
